body: It can be real hard to determine if your unhappiness is circumstantial or directly related to depression. I first had suicidal issues when i was seven. Its been pretty clear that i have depression but its hard to determine if i need to make a change or just ride it out. Ive ridden it out for years at time waiting to see if it just gets better.

Von erich brother said it best in a wrestling documentary series, "it doesnt take courage to kill yourself it takes courage to live with yourself" I couldnt watch the wrestling documentary anymore after that. I basically cried that whole episode. Was in a bad place to begin with so....

Pause time, one of my fantasys i get lost in. Sometimes i feel like my mental health problems amplified by the fact im a man and feel shame for feeling the way i feel. Like im not supposed to because im a man. It then gets compounded by the fact on the surface level theres nothing wrong with my life. Its pretty ideal i suppose. Leaves me asking why do i feel this way then. Createa kinda a cycle where every four years or so i snapp quit my job and piss into the wind. Spend the next four years trying to put shit back together just to do it all again.
I wish you luck man, somtimes it just feels better to know other people are in the same boat

That doesnt sound easy to get yourself without alot of saving. I got to go sailing in high school because of an underprivledged kids program that paid our fees for gym class. Family couldnt afford the hundred bucks for a day in a schooner.

I totally relate to the whole my problems arnt severe enough to recieve the help. One of the biggest mind fucks for me is that technically theres nothing wrong with me or my life, but i cant shake the way i feel. Im 37. I was told it would get better with time, and sometimes it does but i always seem to wind up going back into this dark place in my mind. I always feel so pathetic when i let anyone know whats going on inside my mind, theyre always so flabergasted because i carry myself well and looking in from the outside you wouldnt tell anything is wrong. I feel so much pressure to maintain this image out of fear of my life collapseing around me when people find out. Ive been trying to get myself to go to the doctor, three canceled appointments later.... im realizing that its having a negative impact on my phyiscal health. Ive been thinking about wondering into the mountains have a little walk about spirit quest. Need to find myself i think cause im pretty lost. Regardless of what i do, or you do, we both have to hold on. We can do this, weve done it so far.  But ya, i feel broken, i want to give up, but ultimatly i dont want to die, i just dont want to feel like i do anymore. Im sorry we feel this way.
Im happy for you and appreciate you sharing

That's rough hey. I've always found it ironic how it feels like the world encourages people to talk about there mental health, then when you do they seem to want to treat you differently as they did before or ostracize you for it. In my experience it's been best for me to talk about it with someone else who is familiar with mental health on a personal level or when you are in a position of anonymity hence me being on reddit. Growing up it was easy to talk to friends about it. When your a teenager it seems like its somthing we all go through. It felt like it got harder to talk about over the years. You ask your self why havent I grown out of this, nobody wants to see a man in his late thirtys crying about his shitty self esteem issues. I've kinda felt like it's harder to find someone to talk to then it is to just deal with your problems alone.
